thread:
Maria Chen: seeing a spike of 401s hitting /v1/complete from multiple customers since 15:03 PST. Started right after the scheduled key rotation job. Errors look like: 'invalid_signature' and a bunch of token-broker 502/504s. cc @Katie (oncall)
AJ: copying — any customer examples or curl we can repro with?
Maria Chen: here's a minimal repro from a customer request (redacted):
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
response: 401 {"error":"invalid_signature", "detail":"no matching jwk"}
logs from token-broker:
```
2024-12-04T22:03:12Z token-broker ERROR upstream req to auth-svc timed out (504)
2024-12-04T22:03:13Z auth-svc WARN jwks refresh failed: context deadline exceeded
2024-12-04T22:03:14Z token-broker ERROR signature verification failed: no key found for kid: k-2024-12-04-rotation
```
Samir Patel: interesting — sounds like the new signing key was created but not yet propagated to all auth instances. Are the rotation jobs set to atomic cutover?
Maria Chen: yes rotation job completed at 22:02:55Z per the rotation logs, but the jwks service logs show intermittent 5xx during propagation window.
Katie (oncall): oncall-bot has opened INC-2024-7422 and tagged SRE. @Samir can you validate KMS and jwks cache state? Please call if you need help with rollback. :rotating_light:
SRE Bot: Incident INC-2024-7422 created by Katie (oncall) — severity: P1 — auth failures across hosted API.
Samir Patel: checking now. Quick commands:
```bash
kubectl -n auth get pods -l app=auth -o wide
kubectl logs <auth-pod> | grep jwks
```
Samir Patel: auth pods 3/5 showing older jwks cached, we have 2 pods that restarted during rotation and re-fetched keys successfully, but 3 pods are still serving stale cache and returning 401s. Token-broker is rejecting tokens signed with new kid on those pods.
AJ: is there a config to accept both old and new keys for a short window?
Samir Patel: yes — the auth service supports a fallback window if jwks contains both keys. We should be able to re-run the rotation job with --preserve-old flag or push a hotfix that serves both keys.
Katie (oncall): mitigation plan?
Maria Chen: customers are impacted. Suggest immediate mitigation: 1) scale auth pods to force re-fetch, 2) enable fallback (serve old key alongside new) or rollback signing key to previous one, 3) increase token-broker retries to reduce 502 noise.
Samir Patel: I'm scaling auth to 6 replicas to force all to re-fetch JWKS now.
(SYSTEM): deploy-bot: scaled deployment/auth to 6 replicas in namespace auth by Samir Patel.
Samir Patel: rolling restart in progress. Patch ready to enable preserve-old flag, sending patch now.
AJ: can you paste the patch?
Samir Patel: patch snippet:
```yaml
- name: auth-service
  env:
    - name: JWKS_PRESERVE_OLD
      value: "true"
```
Samir Patel: applied. Auth pods are restarting to pick up env.
Maria Chen: after restart, seeing fewer 401s in logs, token-broker shows successful verification for new tokens. Customers reporting restored. :thumbsup:
Katie (oncall): how long until stable? any residual errors?
Maria Chen: around 15 minutes of elevated 401s burst; some customers saw retries fail and reported higher latency due to token-broker retries. Billing/usage logs show a small spike in error-handling CTs but no double-billing.
Samir Patel: root cause hypothesis: rotation workflow did not atomically publish new key to JWKS store before switching token issuance to new kid; race with pod restarts caused inconsistent JWKS reads. We'll run postmortem and add a pre-cutover validation step.
AJ: please capture exact repro steps for postmortem. Maria, can you attach customer request ids and sample logs to the incident?
Maria Chen: attached in INC-2024-7422 — included 4 customer request IDs, token-broker traces, and auth pod logs.
Katie (oncall): immediate followups: 1) add pre-rollout JWKS consistency check 2) make rotation job write both keys to jwks and only cut issuance once >=90% pods report new key 3) add alert for jwks 5xx and token verification spike 4) run tabletop w/ infra & security teams. I'll create JIRAs.
Samir Patel: also tightening the retry/backoff in token-broker and adding a short TTL grace for jwks cache during rotations.
Maria Chen: customers impacted notified via support. Several opened tickets but mitigation fixed the production impact.
AJ: nice containment. Any need to rollback?
Samir Patel: not needed after preserve-old flag; rotation will be re-run with the new safer workflow later today.
Katie (oncall): thanks team. Postmortem ETA 48h, will include timeline and action owners. Adding follow-up: ensure rotation playbook has a checklist that includes scaling and verifying pod jwks state pre-cutover. :memo:
Maria Chen: logging one more note — token-broker metrics must expose mismatch rate by kid so we can alert earlier.
SRE Bot: Incident INC-2024-7422 status changed to: mitigated — monitoring.
Maria Chen: closing thread here, but will update incident doc after postmortem. Thanks everyone. :heart:
